sentences.en: Do not punish the girl severely; go easy on her.
sentences.zh: 不要严厉地惩罚那个女孩；对她宽容一些。

sentences.en: It is impossible to speak too severely of his conduct.
sentences.zh: 他的行为再怎么严厉批评也不为过。

sentences.en: Some got pretty scratched up, but nobody was severely injured.
sentences.zh: 有些人受了点伤，但没有人严重受伤。

senses.zh: 严格地严厉地严重地严肃地朴实无华地
